description: Contact Litport support: start a conversation with a first message. Without LITPORT_API_KEY this is a guest conversation: "email" is required (where we can reach you) and only general questions can be answered; at most 3 new guest conversations per hour. With LITPORT_API_KEY it is the account's own conversation, where support can help with orders and proxies, and "email" is not used. Replies are not instant: call get_support_replies about every 30 seconds. To add to a conversation that already exists, use reply_to_support. Never put API keys or proxy passwords in the message.

email.description: Required without LITPORT_API_KEY; not used with it.

message.description: The question or request, up to 4,000 characters.

name: contact_support
